profile.headline: Senior software engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Oracle Database, .SQL Databases, .NET Framework, HTML, C#, JAVA and C++

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Software specialist developer, supporting the Global Alfabet application directory platform.
As a specialist developer I was in charge of supporting, developing and implementing new changes in the Alfabet Application tool; this includes gather and develop requirements, documenting and interact with the final user during the implementation process.
Also implemented the solution to allow third party applications to communicate via API to the Alfabet
environment.
Support and develop in house software for invoicing and financial department.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Design, develop and document software solutions based on customer requirements.
Gather and describe requirements along with the customer for later development and deployment.
Review and debug code wrote for other developers.
Drive interview for new candidates.
Production support.
(Sometimes) Merge and build code.

positions.title: BDA
positions.description:
Design and implementation of three software solutions to manage wiring boards, creating tools and to warehouse truck processing.
Maintenance and improvement of the custom system to manage exporting goods.
Production support

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
To support production system issues and new changes required by process changes.
Develop new website for technical support ticket management
Develop and test new version of the system production software.
Complete testing and integration of the system.

positions.title: Software
positions.description:
Database development and maintenance.
Problem solving of the reported issues in the system by users.
IT and development supervisor, developing solutions for the local plant and further locations
